what: the differential run's 219 queries on relate-db 1.4.0, each answer compared with the recorded answer of relate-db 1.0.1, relate-db 1.3.0 and Neo4j (the recorded engine first in every pair)

relate_1_0_1.cypher: MATCH (a:Airport) RETURN percentileDisc(a.altitude, 0) AS d0, percentileDisc(a.altitude, 0.5) AS d50, percentileDisc(a.altitude, 0.9) AS d90, percentileDisc(a.altitude, 1) AS d100, percentileCont(a.altitude, 0.5) AS c50, percentileCont(a.altitude, 0.25) AS c25
UNWIND [3, null, 1] AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x NULLS FIRST
MATCH p = SHORTEST 3 (a:Airport {iata:'ZQN'})-[:HAS_ROUTE]->+(b:Airport {iata:'AKL'}) RETURN length(p) AS l ORDER BY l
MATCH p = ANY SHORTEST (a:Airport {iata:'ZQN'})-[r:HAS_ROUTE WHERE r.dist < 5000]->+(b:Airport {iata:'AUS'}) RETURN length(p) AS l
MATCH p = SHORTEST 2 (a:Airport {iata:'AAT'})-[:HAS_ROUTE]-+(b:Airport {iata:'ZQN'}) RETURN length(p) AS l ORDER BY l

RETURN toString(date('2024-02-29')) AS d1, toString(date('2024-02-29') + duration('P1Y')) AS d2, toString(duration.between(date('2024-01-01'), date('2024-03-01'))) AS d3, date('2024-12-31').dayOfYear AS doy

neo4j.cypher: RETURN toString(1.0) AS a, toString(1) AS b, toString(true) AS c, toString(null) AS d, toString(0.1) AS e, toString(100000000000000000000.0) AS f, toString(1.0E-7) AS g, toString(-0.0) AS h, toString(123456789012) AS i
UNWIND [3, null, 1] AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x NULLS FIRST
MATCH p = SHORTEST 1 (a:Airport {iata:'ZQN'})-[:HAS_ROUTE]->+(b:Airport {iata:'HEL'}) RETURN length(p) AS hops
MATCH p = ALL SHORTEST (a:Airport {iata:'ZQN'})-[:HAS_ROUTE]->+(b:Airport {iata:'AUS'}) RETURN count(p) AS n, min(length(p)) AS l
MATCH p = SHORTEST 3 (a:Airport {iata:'ZQN'})-[:HAS_ROUTE]->+(b:Airport {iata:'AKL'}) RETURN length(p) AS l ORDER BY l
MATCH p = ANY SHORTEST (a:Airport {iata:'ZQN'})-[r:HAS_ROUTE WHERE r.dist < 5000]->+(b:Airport {iata:'AUS'}) RETURN length(p) AS l
MATCH p = SHORTEST 2 (a:Airport {iata:'AAT'})-[:HAS_ROUTE]-+(b:Airport {iata:'ZQN'}) RETURN length(p) AS l ORDER BY l

RETURN toString(date('2024-02-29')) AS d1, toString(date('2024-02-29') + duration('P1Y')) AS d2, toString(duration.between(date('2024-01-01'), date('2024-03-01'))) AS d3, date('2024-12-31').dayOfYear AS doy

relate_1_3_0.cypher: UNWIND [3, null, 1] AS x RETURN x ORDER BY x NULLS FIRST
MATCH p = ANY SHORTEST (a:Airport {iata:'ZQN'})-[r:HAS_ROUTE WHERE r.dist < 5000]->+(b:Airport {iata:'AUS'}) RETURN length(p) AS l

RETURN toString(date('2024-02-29')) AS d1, toString(date('2024-02-29') + duration('P1Y')) AS d2, toString(duration.between(date('2024-01-01'), date('2024-03-01'))) AS d3, date('2024-12-31').dayOfYear AS doy
